headline: US Gas Executives Assert Abundant Domestic Reserves Support Growth
summary: Industry executives stated at an energy conference that US natural gas reserves are virtually infinite, facing no immediate upstream constraints to support rising demand.
why: The US is the world's largest producer and exporter of natural gas.

impacts.name: US Natural Gas
impacts.why: Producers reaffirmed high potential long-term domestic supply capacity.
